Entry Point 01

CAP Code Enforcement & Adjudication

Compliance Automation

CAP Code Edition 12 and BCAP Code compliance validation for broadcast and non-broadcast advertising including misleading claims, harm, offence, and substantiation standards.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Detection of misleading advertising claims, harmful content patterns, and systematic regulatory non-compliance from advertising monitoring and complaint trend analysis.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

NLP analysis of advertising copy, claims substantiation dossiers, and creative briefs against CAP Code rules, BCAP rules, and ASA precedent adjudication rulings.

Predictive Analytics

Advertising complaint escalation prediction from claim type, advertiser history, media channel, consumer vulnerability factors, and seasonal complaint patterns.

Evidence Synthesis

Complaint records, adjudication data, advertising creative assets, and substantiation evidence into regulatory compliance intelligence dossiers.

Document Intelligence

Extraction from advertising claims documentation, substantiation evidence submissions, and compliance records for ASA Council adjudication panels.

Stakeholder Reporting

ASA enforcement dashboards showing complaint volumes by sector, adjudication outcomes, compliance rates, repeat offender tracking, and industry benchmarking.

Real-time Monitoring

Real-time advertising complaint monitoring, adjudication pipeline tracking, compliance alert distribution, and media landscape scanning for emerging risks.
